snippet.title: Cassette Beasts Mobile | Launching January 15 on iOS and Android!
snippet.description:
Cassette Beasts is coming to iOS and Android on January 15th! Try on your mobile device to find out why this imaginative journey of exploration and friendship is one of the best-reviewed PC games of 2023!

Pre-register on Google Play (Goes live on Jan 15): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.RawFury.CassetteBeasts 
Pre-order on the Apple Store: https://apps.apple.com/sg/app/cassette-beasts/id6736517805

Cassette Beasts, the open-world RPG that lets you collect and transform into awesome monsters in thrilling turn-based battles, is coming Jan 15 to Android and iOS.
